subject: NFS Concept Art Hoax
author: ZombieTron
body:
There was a hoax online a few days ago, the details of which I will share here... Criterion games tweeted that the following images and game details are 100% fake, which I am glad about, because frankly it doesn't sound or look all that great!! Anyway... for the sake of curiosity, here are the hoax pics and details:

NFSGame.net claims to have the first pieces of concept art and details (originating from fansite NFSUnlimited) of Criterion's effort, outing a game called Need for Speed: Out of the Law. The images show off a Mazda MX-5, Nissan Skyline R32 and what was a new addition to Burnout Paradise post-release: racing bikes. Apparently Out of the Law (that's a really odd title) will take place in the fictional city of Bay City Sun -- a take on on San Francisco, slightly larger than the world in NFS: Undercover -- and features day/night cycles and various weather conditions. There's also mention of "strengthened" police patrols that can also ride motorcycles.
